name: Pan-Fried Falafel Patties with Tzatziki & Tomato-Cucumber Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small pkg grape tomatoes
3 English cucumbers
1 ½ lemon
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the chickpeas; place on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Transfer to a large bowl and, using a potato masher or fork, mash into a paste.

Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ of the parsley to the bowl with the chickpeas and transfer the other ½ to a medium salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add ½ of the garlic to the bowl with the chickpeas and transfer the other ½ to a small bowl.
Juice the lemons; add ½ of the juice to the bowl with the chickpeas and add the other ½ to the small bowl with the garlic.
Add olive oil to a nonstick skillet and heat over medium-high heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: To the bowl of chickpeas, add olive oil, flour, coriander, cumin, salt, and pepper; stir until well combined. Form the mixture into 18 patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
4 ½ tbsp all-purpose flour
3 tsp coriander
3 tsp cumin
2 ¼ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add patties and cook until golden brown and crispy, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate. Repeat with the remaining patties and more olive oil.
Halve the grape tomatoes and add to the salad bowl with the parsley.

Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumbers; coarsely grate 3/4 of one cucumber and add to the bowl with the garlic and lemon juice, then quarter the remaining cucumbers lengthwise and cut crosswise into 6-mm-thick pieces. Add to the salad bowl.
Add yogurt to the bowl with the garlic, lemon juice, and cucumber; season with salt and pepper and mix together.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To the salad bowl, add olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place the patties on a plate, add the salad on the side, and serve with tzatziki sauce. Enjoy!
